description: This PHP source file defines the Activity class within the Opencart framework. The class contains multiple methods that act as event handlers for various customer-related activities such as adding, editing, and deleting customers, addresses, transactions, referrals, and orders. The methods typically check configuration settings, load necessary models, and record activities to an activity log based on triggered events in the e-commerce system.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Handles customer activity logging in response to various events such as registration, login, address changes, transactions, and orders within the Opencart e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Logs an activity when a new customer registers, recording the customer ID and name.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Logs when a customer updates their details, recording customer ID and name.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Logs password change or reset activities, handling both logged-in and guest password resets.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs customer login activity based on route and configuration settings.

methods.name: forgotten
methods.description: Logs password reset requests triggered by forgotten password procedures.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Logs when a transaction is added to a customer's account, including order ID.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Logs when an affiliate account is created.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Logs edits to an affiliate account.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Logs new address additions for a customer.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Logs customer or guest return requests, including return ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Logs order status changes, distinguishing between customer and guest orders.
